events.title: 아테네 명문가에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born into a noble Athenian family
events.description: 아테네 알리모스 구역의 명문가에서 태어났다. 아버지 올로로스는 트라키아 지역의 금광 이권과 연이 있었다.
events.description_en: He was born into a noble family in the deme of Halimous, Athens. His father, Oloros, held ties to gold-mining interests in Thrace.

events.title: 역병에 걸렸다가 살아남다
events.title_en: He caught the plague and survived it
events.description: 아테네를 휩쓴 역병에 걸렸다가 살아남았다. 이 경험을 바탕으로 증상을 임상적으로 기록해 훗날 역사서에 남겼다.
events.description_en: He contracted the plague that swept through Athens and survived it. Drawing on that experience, he recorded its symptoms with clinical precision in his history.

events.title: 전쟁이 터지자마자 기록을 시작하다
events.title_en: He began recording the war as soon as it broke out
events.description: 펠로폰네소스 전쟁이 시작되자 곧바로 기록에 나섰다. 이 전쟁이 이전 어떤 전쟁보다 클 것이라 내다보고 처음부터 자료를 모았다.
events.description_en: As soon as the Peloponnesian War broke out he began keeping a record of it. He judged it would be greater than any war before and started gathering material from the outset.

events.title: 장군으로 뽑혀 트라키아 함대를 맡다
events.title_en: He was elected general and given command of the Thracian fleet
events.description: 아테네의 열 장군 중 하나로 뽑혀 트라키아 방면 함대를 맡았다. 타소스섬에 근거를 두고 그 일대를 지켰다.
events.description_en: He was elected one of Athens's ten generals and put in command of the fleet in the Thracian theater, based on the island of Thasos.

events.title: 암피폴리스를 브라시다스에게 내주다
events.title_en: Amphipolis fell to Brasidas before he could arrive
events.description: 스파르타 장군 브라시다스가 암피폴리스를 치자 구원에 나섰다. 도착하기 전에 성이 항복해, 도시를 지켜내지 못했다.
events.description_en: When the Spartan general Brasidas struck Amphipolis, he moved to relieve it. The city surrendered before he arrived, and he failed to save it.

events.title: 패전 책임으로 추방되다
events.title_en: He was exiled over the defeat
events.description: 암피폴리스를 지키지 못한 책임을 지고 아테네에서 추방됐다. 이후 스무 해를 조국 밖에서 지냈다.
events.description_en: He was exiled from Athens for failing to hold Amphipolis. He spent the next twenty years away from his homeland.

events.title: 추방 중에 양쪽 진영을 함께 지켜보다
events.title_en: During exile he watched both sides of the war
events.description: 추방된 몸으로 아테네와 스파르타 양쪽 진영을 오가며 전황을 살필 수 있었다. 특히 펠로폰네소스 쪽 사정을 가까이서 볼 기회가 생겨, 이를 기록에 반영했다.
events.description_en: As an exile he was able to move between the Athenian and Spartan camps and watch the war from both sides. He gained particular access to the Peloponnesian side, and that vantage shaped his history.

events.title: 전쟁이 끝나고 아테네로 돌아오다
events.title_en: He returned to Athens after the war ended
events.description: 펠로폰네소스 전쟁이 끝나고 일반 사면이 내려지자 스무 해 만에 아테네로 돌아왔다고 전한다.
events.description_en: When the Peloponnesian War ended and a general amnesty was declared, he is said to have returned to Athens after twenty years away.

events.title: 기록을 끝맺지 못한 채 죽다
events.title_en: He died leaving his history unfinished
events.description: 『펠로폰네소스 전쟁사』는 기원전 411년의 사건에서 갑자기 끊긴다. 트라키아에서 죽었다는 설과 아테네에 돌아와 암살됐다는 설이 있으나 확인할 길이 없다.
events.description_en: His History of the Peloponnesian War breaks off abruptly in the events of 411 BC. Some say he died in Thrace, others that he was murdered after returning to Athens, and neither can be confirmed.
